title: my asset factory turned into a holodeck, all code and assets are open source
author: MattMaxBuilds
selftext:
started with an asset factory where you make parts to assemble an asset. the same principles were applied to constructing scenes.

this is my attempt at a holodeck, powered by kiln. the assets are authored in code with kiln, no Blender modeling involved, so you can edit the parts, change how they fit together, and build something else from them. all assets are CC0, and the code is open source.

any model, any harness, any engine.\*

made a little how it’s made-style film showing the factory, reference boards, four environments coming together, and the Maker enjoying the results. the factory and construction sequences are staged for the film; the environments and reference-board workflow are from the actual project.

\*built on three.js today. Unity and Unreal Engine extensions are in progress, with easily maintainable twins across engines as the goal.

repo: [https://github.com/instruktlabs/holodeck](https://github.com/instruktlabs/holodeck)  
powered by kiln: [https://github.com/instruktlabs/kiln](https://github.com/instruktlabs/kiln)

use it, fork it, remix it. would love to see what you build.
